{"type":"text","timestamp":1794628105696,"sessionID":"ses_e27d6fd6affeMujnbkJZMJcHXl","part":{"id":"prt_1d82bb5d5001T6lnpfS0IfZ6pW","messageID":"msg_1d82b94e6001sdcaZK8VJzdz5k","sessionID":"ses_e27d6fd6affeMujnbkJZMJcHXl","type":"text","text":"The episode is over. The rover sampled all 7 targets and finished at base, and I expect a score of about **0.875** (10.5 out of 12). The simulator didn't report a score, so that number is my own calculation from the sample results in telemetry.\n\n- **On time:** t1, t2, t3, t4, t5 and the discovered target d2, worth 10 in total.\n- **Late:** the second discovered target, d1, worth 2. It appeared at tick 11 with a deadline of 21, but the rover was already committed to t4. It was sampled at tick 23 for 0.5 (the 0.25 late rate).\n- **End position:** about 0.11 m from base, well inside the 0.75 m radius. The last drive executed at tick 31 and the rover waited there until tick 50.\n- **Battery:** the forecast at tick 50 is about 0.15. The last packet I received (tick 47) showed 1.646, and three more idle ticks cost 1.5. The rover was alive in every packet.\n\nThe battery margin was deliberately thin. Including d1 left only about 0.4 energy spare, and the final drive brought it to about 0.15. Drive and sample costs are fixed by the commanded wheel metres, so I could count the energy exactly, and it stayed positive. The trade-off was that there was no energy left to fix a missed approach at d1 or at base. Without d1 the margin would have been about 10, and the score would have been 10/12, about 0.83, if everything else went the same.\n\nTwo things kept every sample on time except d1:\n- **Slip:** I measured it on bedrock from telemetry at about 0.015 to 0.045, and corrected the later drives with it.\n- **Sampling radius:** I stopped up to 0.5 m short of target centres, still inside the 0.75 m radius. That let d2 and t4 each be reached in time for their tick-18 deadlines. Driving to the centres would have taken another tick and made t4 late.","time":{"start":1794628105685,"end":1794628105695}}}
